edits.model_reason: Source S2fbf3e5eb127 attributes the 'tax vs cess' finding to the trial Court in its March 31, 1939 judgment, not the Additional Civil Judge during the 1942 application phase.

Clarifies that because the accounting start date was not raised in the High Court, its admissibility in the Supreme Court depends on it being a 'substantial question of law' under CPC s.110, linking the omission to the legal tension.

Refines the inference to state that the lower court already treated the deeds as continuous (S111ddbfcfbeb), shifting the focus to whether this treatment aligns with statutory definitions in the final review.
